name: Docker MCP Server
shortDescription: Manage containers, images, volumes, inspect container logs, and orchestrate Docker Compose stacks.
longDescription: Empower coding assistants to manage Docker containers, inspect container resource utilization, tail container logs, build Dockerfiles, and execute commands inside running containers safely.
author: docker-mcp

tools.name: list_containers
tools.description: List running and stopped Docker containers.

tools.name: get_container_logs
tools.description: Fetch stdout/stderr logs from a container.

tools.name: inspect_container
tools.description: Inspect detailed container configuration, ports, and mounts.

prerequisites: Docker Engine or Docker Desktop running locally
